summary: The official React integration for X6 v3. MIT, zero runtime dependencies, React 18/19 peers and bundled types; a React 19 spike rendered 20 interactive nodes with selection. It is browser-only, has no npm provenance, and its last release is close to the 12-month maintenance boundary.
reasoning: It is the official X6 React shape package, so React nodes use the supported foreignObject path instead of an application-specific DOM hack.
The peer range is React >=18, React DOM >=18 and @antv/x6 ^3.x, which covers the reviewed X6 3.1.8 and both React 18 and 19.
The package declares no runtime dependencies; the shipped runtime tree is the X6 core, React and this package, all MIT or permissive.
A local React 19.2.0 spike rendered 20 React-rendered nodes and 20 edges, mounted in 17 ms, and a button click updated component state; selection also worked.
The package is MIT, has bundled declarations and no install scripts.
It is not separately provenance-signed; the decision must pin 3.0.1 exactly and record the gap, as the requirement allows.
The last npm release was 2025-11-27. That is inside the 12-month window today but expires on 2026-11-27, so the next review must check whether the package has been released again.
caveats: Browser-only: the package renders through foreignObject and the X6 core still fails native Node ESM/CJS loading. Do not use it in SSR or Node-side rendering.
No npm provenance. Pin 3.0.1 exactly and record the gap.
The last release is 2025-11-27. If no new release ships by 2026-11-27, the active-maintenance constraint is no longer met and the React path needs a new decision.
The React provider API changed in v3; the spike used getProvider() and the 3.x package. Do not pair it with X6 v2 or the deprecated 3.0.0 plugin packages.
The spike covers rendering, a component state update and selection, not the full application regression suite.

evidence.label: Licence
evidence.detail: MIT. The runtime tree for the spike is X6 (MIT; its deps are MIT except mousetrap, Apache-2.0 WITH LLVM-exception), tslib (0BSD), React and React DOM (MIT), and this package (MIT). No commercial or copyleft licence is introduced.

evidence.label: React compatibility
evidence.detail: peerDependencies: react >=18.0.0, react-dom >=18.0.0, @antv/x6 ^3.x. The spike used React 19.2.0 with X6 3.1.8.

evidence.label: Dependency footprint
evidence.detail: 0 runtime dependencies. Peers are supplied by the application. Unpacked size is 1,044 KB; install size was not separately measured.

evidence.label: TypeScript types
evidence.detail: Bundled declarations are present in the published package.

evidence.label: Known advisories
evidence.detail: OSV returned no advisories for @antv/x6-react-shape@3.0.1 at review time.

evidence.label: Maintenance
evidence.detail: 3.0.1 published 2025-11-27; the AntV X6 repository was pushed 2026-10-23. The package itself has not shipped in almost 12 months, so the boundary is 2026-11-27.

evidence.label: SLSA provenance
evidence.detail: No npm attestation was found for 3.0.1. Pin the exact version and record the gap.

evidence.label: Publish pipeline
evidence.detail: Not audited. The package is published from the AntV X6 monorepo, but no OIDC or release workflow evidence was collected for this sub-package.

evidence.label: React browser spike
evidence.detail: A Vite production build rendered 20 React-rendered nodes and 20 edges in Chrome 1200x800. Mount was 17 ms, bundle was 782.82 KB JS / 231.62 KB gzip including React 19.2.0, a node button click updated component state, and selection worked.

evidence.label: Install scripts
evidence.detail: The package declares no preinstall, install or postinstall script, and it has no runtime dependencies.
